reports.title: St. Joseph River (below Twin Branch Dam) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth bass are still a good bet, using crankbaits, jerkbaits, ned rigs, and topwater during low light periods.
reports.lake: St. Joseph River (below Twin Branch Dam)

reports.title: Lake Michigan (boat) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth bass should be putting on the fall feedbag as temps cool off.

reports.title: Lake Monroe fishing report
reports.text: Crappie fishing has been very good on Lake Monroe with boat and shore anglers catching both lots of fish and large fish. Lots of Largemouth Bass were collected with fish in the 2-5 pound range being common.

reports.title: West Boggs Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie fishing has been good. A recent Bass tournament saw some good Largemouth Bass being caught, including the big fish at 5.99 pounds

reports.title: Patoka Lake fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth are being caught on top water and moving/cranking baits in the shallows. Crappie will begin moving into the shallows as well and can be caught on small jigs and minnows. Anglers can have success catching crappie targeting structures along shallow points and shoreline.

reports.title: Northwest Indiana Lakes fishing report
reports.text: As the water cools, look for aggressive bass with jerkbaits, chatterbaits, or topwater on inside weedlines, dropoffs, and near docks.

reports.title: Big Turkey Lake fishing report
reports.text: Anglers reporting catching bass using Texas rig, swim baits, and chatterbaits.
